stories.title: NFL preseason Week 1 takeaways: Tagovailoa's uncomfortable night; Dolphins WR shines
stories.summary: The NFL preseason is underway! How did rookies and players in new places perform in their debuts?

stories.title: Clark-Bueckers clash lives up to hype in Fever win
stories.summary: Caitlin Clark and Paige Bueckers went blow for blow with dueling 29-point performances, with Clark's Fever coming out on top 98-87 against Bueckers' short-handed Wings.

stories.title: Tua 'frustrated' by play in Falcons' preseason loss
stories.summary: Falcons quarterback Tua Tagovailoa said he was "frustrated and disappointed" after a preseason loss to the Broncos, during which he played two series and was 3-of-5 passing for 22 yards.

stories.title: Vols' Farooq (torn patellar tendon) out for season
stories.summary: Tennessee starting safety Edrees Farooq will miss the 2026 season after suffering a torn patellar tendon in his right knee in practice.

stories.title: Scheffler's 'dream' 61 ties course mark in Memphis
stories.summary: Scottie Scheffler birdied the first five holes and shot a 9-under 61 to take a three-stroke lead in the FedEx St. Jude Championship.
